typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	RunLoadDate as timestamp (),
	RunLoadId as integer (),
	machineName as string (),
	productVersion as string (),
	startTime as string (),
	versionBuild as string (),
	versionGUID as string (),
	versionMajor as string (),
	versionMinor as string ()
}

source(output(
		SourceSystemCode as string,
		StartTime as timestamp,
		EndTime as timestamp,
		MachineName as string,
		ProductVersion as string,
		TimeElapsed as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT max([SourceSystemCode]) [SourceSystemCode]       , min(  [StartTime2]  ) [StartTime] 	  , max(   [endTime]) EndTime 	                   ,max([MachineName]) [MachineName]       ,max([ProductVersion]) [ProductVersion]                         	  , TimeElapsed= DATEDIFF ( MINUTE , min(  [StartTime2]  ) ,  max(   [endTime]) )   FROM       (   select  *,   [StartTime2]=case when [LogMessage] =\'DW Load Started\' then [StartTime] end 	  from  [Temp].[Logs]   ) t',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(MachineName = toString($machineName),
		ProductVersion = toString($productVersion),
		StartTime = $startTime,
		VersionBuild = $versionBuild,
		VersionGUID = toString($versionGUID),
		VersionMajor = $versionMajor,
		VersionMinor = $versionMinor,
		RunId = $RunLoadId,
		RunLoadDate = $RunLoadDate) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		VersionBuild as integer,
		VersionMinor as integer,
		MachineName as string,
		EndTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		VersionGUID as string,
		VersionMajor as integer,
		StartTime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SourceSystemCode as string,
		ProductVersion as string,
		ElapseTimeMinutes as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		VersionBuild,
		VersionMinor,
		MachineName,
		EndTime,
		VersionGUID,
		VersionMajor,
		StartTime,
		SourceSystemCode,
		ProductVersion,
		ElapseTimeMinutes = TimeElapsed)) ~> DSTLoadControllog
